searches.answer: Kubernetes 1.20 introduced a deprecation warning for Docker runtime support, which is planned to be removed in version 1.22. Kubernetes is deprecating Docker as a container runtime due to its non-compliance with the Container Runtime Interface (CRI) for Kubernetes. Users are advised to switch to compliant container runtimes like containerd or CRI-O before the removal in future releases. The latest Kubernetes release is 1.37.1, with the latest patch for 1.36 being 1.36.5. Kubernetes and Docker continue to evolve to meet modern application demands, with Kubernetes focusing on container runtime advancements.
